rationale: Shiza's hands-on approach to building frontier hardware (humanoid robotics at 1X, now leading Haptile) complements Georgi's conviction that workflow automation tools are best built for non-technical domain experts—both share a philosophy of building under-the-radar with conviction rather than polish-first. While Shiza brings deep technical depth in computer vision and robotics subsystems, Georgi's GTM expertise and community-driven growth motion via hackathons could surface new applications or partnerships for Haptile's hardware, and Shiza's track record as a recognized AI builder might inform how Rilo positions automation tools for hardware teams.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Georgi Boby—you both believe in hands-on building with conviction over hype, and Shiza's robotics hardware background combined with Georgi's GTM motion expertise could unlock new use cases at the intersection of automation and physical systems.
